desc: The Caldwell AR500 Dueling Tree is a great way to compete against friends or hone your skills by yourself on almost any range. With each impact, the six reactive targets pivot from left to right of the center post. A unique AR500 steel 2-piece center post and plate hangers withstand bullet impacts for a lifetime of trouble-free use. Get the Caldwell AR500 Dueling Tree and head to the range to Eliminate the Variables That Make You Miss. Rated for handgun at 10 yards, .223 Remington at 100 yards and .308 Winchester at 200 yards.
